correctness.rationale: Legendre gives v2(binomial(2r,r))=s2(r). For odd n, term k=n-1 has valuation 3*s2(n-1) because 3n-2 odd; earlier k=n-1-j contribute at least 4j+3s2(n-1-j)>=3s2(n-1)+j, hence unique least 2-adic valuation. For n=2 mod4, the recurrence S_n=16S_{n-1}+(3n-2)binom(2n-2,n-1)^3 has first-term valuation 3s2(n-1)+1 using odd n-1 and digit addition, while the last term has at least 3s2(n-1)+2. No cancellation changes the first minimum. n divisible by 4 is explicitly excluded. Independently computed recurrence and valuations at 135 qualifying positive indices.
